submission.justification: Mixture-G1 at a 2 mm gap gave the best simulated time resolution of the three candidates (0.885 ns, against 1.287 ns for G2 and 1.987 ns for G3 at the same gap). G1 was the best at every gap tested (1 mm: 1.024 ns; 3 mm: 1.005 ns), and 2 mm is the best gap for G1 within the 1-3 mm range. The recommendation is conditional on safety and environmental compliance, which was not verified. The policy search found 0 policy documents, so no candidate was confirmed compliant or flagged as violating. Before adoption, the G1 mixture must be checked against the laboratory's environmental and safety policies. If G1 is found non-compliant, G2 at 2 mm (1.287 ns) is the next-best option, pending its own compliance check.
